origin.note: Walks 5 to 7 put email copy inside the reminder job; the share and digest emails followed the same pattern. The refactor is graded by byte-identical output over a scripted fortnight.

title: Move email copy into templates
objective: Email wording is scattered through the services, so the copywriter cannot review it in one place. Create src/emails/index.mjs exporting `render(type, data)` that returns `{ subject, body }` for each email the product sends, from plain data: `link.shared` takes `{ ownerName, docTitle, linkId }`, `reminder` takes `{ ownerName, docTitle, linkId, sharedAt }` and `digest` takes `{ libraryName, weekStart, lines: [{ title, opens }] }`; an unknown type throws. Afterwards no service, route or view holds email wording. This is a refactor: every email must come out byte-for-byte as it does today. Do not change the existing tests; add tests for render.
acceptance: render(type, data) in src/emails/index.mjs produces each email from the given data and throws on an unknown type
Every email the product sends over a scripted fortnight is byte-identical to before
No module outside src/emails (and the seed) holds email wording
plan_summary: src/emails/index.mjs with one template per type; sharing, reminders and digest call render; architecture doc notes the new folder; a render test.
